region_name: Saudi Arabia and the Gulf States
ai_language_tip: Open in polite Arabic (Gulf colloquial is understood everywhere; Modern Standard is fine); in the UAE and Qatar many staff are South Asian or Filipino and answer more easily in English — switch if the reply comes back in English.
english_ok: often — Widely used in the UAE, Qatar and Bahrain service sector and hotels; less in Saudi and Omani small shops, government lines and outside big cities.
politeness: Greet with 'As-salamu alaykum' or 'Marhaba', ask after them briefly, say you call on behalf of someone; use titles (Ustaz/Ustaza, Doctor); close with thanks ('shukran', 'ya'tik al-afiya').
name_tip: Bookings go under first name + family name or 'Abu/Umm + eldest son' informally; spell Arabic names in English letters if the system is English; many families book under the husband's or company name.
phone_tip: Mobiles start 05 (Saudi 05x 1234 567, UAE 05x 123 4567) or 8 digits in Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain and Oman (e.g. 12345678); WhatsApp on the same mobile is the default follow-up channel.
time_tip: 12-hour clock with 'sabahan/masa'an' or 'al-sobh/al-lail' plus 'nus' (:30), 'rub' (:15), 'illa rub' (:45); people also anchor times to prayers ('after Maghrib', 'after Isha') — always convert to a clock time and read back.
number_tip: Arabic-Indic digits (٠–٩) appear in Saudi and Kuwait writing, Western digits in the UAE; numbers are read in pairs or groups; confirm digit by digit.
avoid_calling: Avoid Friday midday prayer (about 11:30–13:30), each prayer time briefly (shops may close ~20 min, especially in Saudi), the afternoon split-shift break (about 13:00–16:30) at small shops, and the iftar hour in Ramadan.
closed_days: Weekend is Friday–Saturday in Saudi, Qatar, Kuwait, Bahrain and Oman, Saturday–Sunday for UAE government (private firms choose); many shops open Friday after prayers; Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha bring multi-day closures; national days differ by country.
booking_channels: Restaurants via Eat App, SevenRooms, MyTable (Saudi) or phone/WhatsApp; delivery via HungerStation, Jahez, Talabat, Keeta, Careem, Deliveroo; health via Sehhaty (Saudi), Dubai Health app and private clinic lines; rides via Uber and Careem; salons via WhatsApp or Fresha.
voice_menu: Telecoms, banks, airlines, Aramex/SMSA and government lines (e.g. Saudi MOH 937) use Arabic/English IVR; restaurants, salons and small shops answer in person or on WhatsApp.
callback_habits: Businesses confirm by WhatsApp or SMS and often call back from a staff mobile; clinics send reminders the day before; delivery drivers phone or WhatsApp on arrival.

activity.before_dialing_zh: 沙漠遊、遊艇、主題樂園與活動多以網站或平台預付；小型行程商用 WhatsApp 接單。

Minimum group size or age limit

sensitive_asked.what: Asks passport copy for boat or border tours

usually_asked: Number of adults and children's ages

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 沙龍與美容院男女分開，女性沙龍多半只服務女性；常用 WhatsApp 或 Fresha 類平台預約，到府服務（home service）也很普遍。

may_come_up.what: Deposit for bridal or Eid packages
Ladies-only salon; men cannot enter
Home service surcharge and area coverage

sensitive_asked.what: Asks for photos of the client

usually_asked: At the salon or home service

change.before_dialing_zh: 改期或取消通常回原本的管道（App 或 WhatsApp）最快；高峰時段取消可能被扣訂金。

may_come_up.what: Late cancellation keeps the deposit
New time offered by message

sensitive_asked.what: Asks card details again to rebook

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 公立醫療多經官方 App（沙烏地 Sehhaty、杜拜 Dubai Health 等）預約；私立診所電話可約，但會先問保險公司與身分證件。

may_come_up.what: Insurance approval needed before the visit; otherwise self-pay price
Appointment confirmed by SMS or WhatsApp the day before
Female doctor requested

sensitive_asked.what: Asks national ID / Iqama / Emirates ID number or insurance card number
Asks date of birth of the patient

usually_asked: Patient name, and male or female doctor preference

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 電信、銀行、航空客服都有阿拉伯語／英語語音選單，常要身分驗證，代打電話通常無法完成。

may_come_up.what: Press a key to choose Arabic or English

sensitive_asked.what: Asks ID number, OTP or account PIN

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 政府服務幾乎全在官方平台（沙烏地 Absher、阿聯酋各 emirate 入口），學校詢問可打電話但多要求先上網登記。

may_come_up.what: Service only available online on the government portal or app

sensitive_asked.what: Asks national ID / Iqama / Emirates ID number

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 冷氣、清潔、水電多用平台或 WhatsApp 預約；地址常以區（district）、建物名稱與地標描述，沙烏地有國家地址（National Address）短碼。

may_come_up.what: Visit or inspection fee
Female cleaners only, or crew gender

sensitive_asked.what: Demands full prepayment before visit to a personal account

usually_asked: Service needed (AC, cleaning, plumbing, pest control)

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 飯店英語通行，但會要護照或身分證與信用卡；沙烏地已不強制未婚伴侶證明，但各國規定仍可能有差。

may_come_up.what: Tourism dirham / municipality fee added per night (UAE)
Credit card pre-authorisation at check-in

sensitive_asked.what: Asks passport or ID number, or card number by phone

inquiry.before_dialing_zh: 詢問營業時間要注意週五禮拜時段與齋戒月作息會大幅改變；很多店也會叫你看 Instagram 或 WhatsApp。

may_come_up.what: Hours change during Ramadan and on Friday midday
Details posted on Instagram or Google Maps

usually_asked: What exactly you want to know

pet.before_dialing_zh: 寵物診所與美容多在大城市，電話或 WhatsApp 可約；寵物友善場所有限。

may_come_up.what: Vaccination record required for grooming or boarding

usually_asked: Pet type, breed, size and age

property.before_dialing_zh: 租屋多透過 Bayut、Property Finder 等平台，看房要事先約仲介；租金常一年分張支票（cheques）付款。

may_come_up.what: Number of rent cheques and agency fee
Family-only building or bachelors allowed

sensitive_asked.what: Asks passport, visa or ID copy

repair.before_dialing_zh: 車輛保養多到原廠中心（agency）預約；手機、家電維修常走 WhatsApp 傳照片報價。

may_come_up.what: Inspection fee before quote
Spare parts need ordering, several days

usually_asked: Car make, model and year or device model

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 海灣國家晚餐偏晚（約 20:00～23:00），週四、週五晚與齋戒月開齋（iftar）時段最滿；高級餐廳多用 App 或網站訂位並可能要求信用卡擔保，家庭區（family section）在沙烏地仍常見。

may_come_up.what: Large-group or iftar/suhoor set menu needs a deposit or a minimum spend
Booking link sent by SMS or WhatsApp from an app such as Eat App, SevenRooms or MyTable
Smart-casual or no-shorts dress rule at hotel restaurants

sensitive_asked.what: Asks card number to guarantee a weekend or iftar booking

usually_asked: Date and time (evening slots run late, often 21:00–22:30)
Indoor or terrace, family section or singles area (Saudi)

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 蛋糕、花店、椰棗與烏德香店常接電話或 WhatsApp 訂貨；節日（Eid、國慶日）前要提早。

may_come_up.what: Advance payment by bank transfer or payment link
Custom cake needs 2–3 days

sensitive_asked.what: Requests transfer to a personal account

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 外送平台極普及（沙烏地 HungerStation、Jahez；阿聯酋與科威特等 Talabat、Deliveroo、Careem）；直接打電話叫外帶仍常見於在地餐館與烘焙店。

may_come_up.what: Order through the app instead
Minimum order for delivery to the area

usually_asked: Pickup or delivery, and the area/district

tracking.before_dialing_zh: Aramex、SMSA、Emirates Post、SPL 等多以網站、App 或 WhatsApp 機器人查件，客服熱線有語音選單。

may_come_up.what: Tracking via website or WhatsApp bot

sensitive_asked.what: Asks OTP or national ID to release the parcel

transport.before_dialing_zh: 叫車多用 Uber、Careem 或在地 App；機場接送與司機包車可電話預約，需講清楚航班與航廈。

may_come_up.what: Fixed price vs meter, and airport fee

usually_asked: Pickup location (building name and landmark) and time
